terrain.heightReference: Approximate mean sea level; source vertical datum has not been independently harmonized with radar altitude
terrain.terrainDate: Not a reconstruction of terrain conditions on May 31, 2013
terrain.purpose: Regional terrain reference for the 3D map. Resampled DEM heights are not measured chaser/GPS altitudes, road-deck elevations, or precision clearance measurements.

attribution: Terrain: Mapzen Terrain Tiles, hosted on AWS Open Data. The downloaded tiles identify SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain imagery, courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.

sources.title: Terrain Tiles on AWS Open Data
Terrain data sources and pixel resolution

provenance.imagerySourceScope: Source filenames reported by the downloaded tiles; per-node source contributions are not individually identified.
provenance.sourceFormat: 256x256 RGB Terrarium PNG, Web Mercator, zoom 10
provenance.horizontalTransform: Inverse spherical azimuthal equidistant using Earth radius 6371000 m, the recorded AIR latitude/longitude, x east and y north
provenance.interpolation: Bilinear interpolation of decoded elevations with integer global pixel coordinates at pixel centers, including neighbors across tile seams
provenance.rounding: Exported kilometers rounded to 0.000001 km (1 mm); numeric storage precision does not imply height accuracy
provenance.modifications: Coordinate transform, bilinear resampling and numeric rounding only. No flattening, terrain offset, geoid correction or synthetic missing-value fill.
provenance.sourceVerticalDatum: The downloaded tiles do not independently establish one harmonized vertical datum. Exact source-datum consistency with AIR altitude is unverified; no NAVD88/EGM96 or ellipsoid conversion is assumed.
